name: Frosty Factory
description: Frosty Factory is a lively karaoke bar known for its friendly atmosphere and diverse crowd. It offers karaoke on Fridays and Saturdays, with a great sound system and a wide selection of songs. The venue features outdoor seating, a drive-thru, and a variety of drinks, including frosty beverages and cocktails. Its welcoming environment and regular karaoke nights make it a popular spot for both locals and tourists seeking fun and entertainment.
